_readme: Config for scripts/pr-leak-scan.sh — the deterministic leak gate over PR diffs.
Copy to .pr-leak-scan.json (gitignored) and replace every value below with YOUR OWN.
The scanner works with no config at all (built-in secret patterns still run);
this file is what teaches it which strings are personal to THIS install.
identity -> HIGH  = a direct leak. Any match blocks the PR (exit 2).
soft     -> MEDIUM = context-dependent. Match alone means 'judge it' (exit 3),
because these strings also appear in legitimate generic docs.
allow      -> regexes for added LINES that are known-benign (placeholders, examples).
skip_files -> regexes for whole PATHS to ignore, e.g. fixtures that hold fake
credentials by design. tests/pr-leak-scan/ is skipped built-in.
Every entry except 'regexes' is matched literally (regex-escaped) and
case-insensitively, on word boundaries. Use 'regexes' only where a literal
cannot express the shape (phone formats, path prefixes, id ranges).
